headline: Law directs the Architect of the Capitol to bury a congressional time capsule for the nation's 250th birthday, to be opened in 2276.
what_it_does: The Architect of the Capitol must bury a time capsule with a plaque in the Capitol Visitor Center by July 4, 2026, holding a joint letter from the top House and Senate leaders and other items they choose, to stay sealed until July 4, 2276, when it will be given to the 244th Congress.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted February 18, 2026; the time capsule must be buried on or before July 4, 2026, and stays sealed until July 4, 2276.
